name: ref
title: External Reference Convention
description: This convention defines a mechanism to reference external node from the attributes of a referencing node (array or group). "External" means that the referenced node is defined elsewhere in the store of the referencing node or in another store. The referenced object may be an array, a group, or an item in a zarr.json file.

name: uom
title: Units of Measure
description: Units of measurement for Zarr arrays

name: proj
title: Geospatial Projection Attribute Extension for Zarr
description: This convention defines properties that encode datum and coordinate reference system (CRS) information for geospatial data.

name: cs
title: Coordinate Set Convention
description: Encodes the coordinate structure of a Zarr array following the CF Metadata Conventions model. Supports Cartesian, curvilinear, and parametric coordinate sets including auxiliary coordinate variables, bounds, formula terms, and CF coordinate typing. Designed to be composed with other conventions for CRS, projection, and domain-specific metadata.
